queries.name: Token Usage Per Agent (Cost Analysis)
queries.description: Aggregate token usage and estimated cost per agent over time
queries.query:
fields @timestamp, AgentName, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, estimated_cost_usd
| filter event = 'agent_response'
| stats sum(input_tokens) as TotalInput, sum(output_tokens) as TotalOutput, sum(estimated_cost_usd) as TotalCost, count(*) as Requests by AgentName
| sort TotalCost desc

queries.name: Slowest Tool Invocations (P95)
queries.description: Find the slowest tool calls across all agents — indicates bottleneck tools
queries.query:
fields @timestamp, agent, tool, duration_ms, success, client_id
| filter event = 'tool_invocation'
| stats avg(duration_ms) as AvgMs, pct(duration_ms, 95) as P95Ms, count(*) as Calls by tool, agent
| sort P95Ms desc
| limit 20

queries.name: Agent Error Patterns
queries.description: Classify and count errors by agent and error type
queries.query:
fields @timestamp, @message
| filter @message like /Error|error|ERROR|Exception|Failed/
| parse @message /(?<error_type>ClientError|ValueError|TimeoutError|Exception|Error)/ as error_type
| stats count(*) as ErrorCount by error_type
| sort ErrorCount desc

queries.name: Memory Hit Rate Per Agent
queries.description: Track how often agent memory retrieval returns useful context vs empty
queries.query:
fields @timestamp, agent, memory_hits, memory_misses
| filter event = 'agent_response'
| stats sum(memory_hits) as Hits, sum(memory_misses) as Misses, sum(memory_hits) / (sum(memory_hits) + sum(memory_misses)) * 100 as HitRatePercent by agent
| sort HitRatePercent desc

queries.name: Compliance Flagging Rate
queries.description: Track ratio of flagged vs approved compliance events
queries.query:
fields @timestamp, event_type, status, client_id
| filter event = 'compliance_check'
| stats count(*) as Total, sum(status = 'FLAGGED') as Flagged, sum(status = 'APPROVED') as Approved by event_type
| sort Total desc

queries.name: Agent Response Time Distribution
queries.description: Latency percentiles per agent for SLA monitoring
queries.query:
fields @timestamp, agent, latency_ms
| filter event = 'agent_response'
| stats avg(latency_ms) as Avg, pct(latency_ms, 50) as P50, pct(latency_ms, 95) as P95, pct(latency_ms, 99) as P99, max(latency_ms) as Max by agent
| sort P95 desc

queries.name: Top Clients by Token Spend
queries.description: Identify highest-cost clients for account management
queries.query:
fields @timestamp, agent, client_id, total_tokens, estimated_cost_usd
| filter event = 'agent_response'
| stats sum(total_tokens) as TotalTokens, sum(estimated_cost_usd) as TotalCost, count(*) as Sessions by client_id
| sort TotalCost desc
| limit 10

queries.name: DynamoDB Latency per Table
queries.description: Track database operation latency to identify hot tables
queries.query:
fields @timestamp, @message
| filter @message like /DYNAMODB RESPONSE/
| parse @message /Table: (?<table>[a-z_]+)/ as table
| parse @message /Duration: (?<duration>[0-9.]+) seconds/ as duration
| stats avg(duration * 1000) as AvgMs, pct(duration * 1000, 95) as P95Ms, count(*) as Ops by table
| sort P95Ms desc

queries.name: Load Test Results Summary
queries.description: Aggregate load test metrics over time
queries.query:
fields @timestamp, @message
| filter @message like /Load test completed/
| parse @message /total=(?<total>\d+), success=(?<success>\d+), fail=(?<fail>\d+), avg=(?<avg>[0-9.]+)ms/ as total, success, fail, avg
| stats sum(total) as TotalRequests, sum(success) as Successes, avg(avg) as AvgLatencyMs by bin(1h)

queries.name: Bedrock Model Invocation Analysis
queries.description: Analyze Bedrock model invocations with token and latency breakdown
queries.query:
fields @timestamp, modelId, inputTokenCount, outputTokenCount, invocationLatency
| stats avg(invocationLatency) as AvgLatency, avg(inputTokenCount) as AvgInput, avg(outputTokenCount) as AvgOutput, count(*) as Invocations by modelId
| sort Invocations desc
